sense.definition: Decorative paper used to cover a present.
sense.meaning: The decorative paper material, not a completed present, ribbon or the action of wrapping.

brief_origin.finding: The inspected evidence identifies the exact three-object arrangement as an AI-authored editorial composition, not a recorded human requirement.
brief_origin.earlier_brief: A present partly wrapped in patterned paper.
brief_origin.current_brief: Show a large loose sheet and partly unrolled roll of decorative paper beside one partly wrapped present, with the paper as the main subject. Use a cheerful repeating motif without text. Reject a completed gift box alone, a wrapping action close-up, a ribbon-only picture, or patterned cloth.

evidence.finding: Identifies the editorial proposal as agent-authored, proposes replacing fifty generic briefs, and contains the exact three-object brief.
Raw file hash matches the accepted proposal hash recorded in integrated editorial provenance.
Acceptance is explicitly an independent AI editorial review; prior and replacement briefs are preserved.
Recorded human approval concerns pronunciation, speed and voice and applies only to exact WAV bytes; it is not picture-composition approval.
General source-asset and art-direction requirements do not prescribe a gift-wrap object arrangement.
Requires inspected, suitably licensed sourced assets, distinct acquisition states and honest pending status; no three-object gift-wrap composition is prescribed.

brief_origin.limit: No human instruction demanding all three objects was found in the inspected records. Unavailable conversation history was not searched, so this is not proof that no such message ever existed.
brief_origin.proposed_brief: Show decorative gift-wrapping paper as the dominant subject, preferably a partly unrolled roll with a broad visible paper tail and a cheerful text-free pattern. Make the paper edge and rolled layers clear. A present may provide optional context. Exclude cloth, ribbon-only imagery, completed gifts alone and distracting clutter.
brief_origin.reason: A single well-chosen patterned roll directly depicts the selected material sense. Requiring a separate sheet and partly wrapped present is unnecessary to that sense and can reduce legibility in small image boxes.

observations.finding: The roll core and colored pattern are small. Root and this reviewer find 48px isolated identification weak; do not enable isolated picture scoring. Transparent crop alone does not enlarge the width-limited silhouette.
The artwork is a tiny pale roll; dots and paper edges are not dependable isolated-answer cues. Do not infer isolated picture eligibility from a larger preview.
The exact alpha crop noticeably improves use of the wide box. The broad patterned tail, thin edge and layered roll are clear, with no gift box or ribbon competing for attention.

observations.finding: The image depicts real patterned sheets, but overlaps and dense patterns resemble fabric or wallpaper swatches at card size. It also has visible brand text near the upper edge. It is weaker than the isolated roll for this sense and is not recommended as the primary word image.

art_direction_assessment.reason: The art direction requires suitable sourced production assets and honest inspection/acquisition states, and does not mandate photographic or 3D treatment for word pictures. This is an acquired authored illustration with curved paper shading, visible rolled layers, a broad unrolled tail and a repeating pattern. Its subject detail is materially stronger than a flat geometric placeholder. The soft pink/green palette reads calmly against the current #fffef9 card fill, while the layered core and patterned tail remain legible in the larger contextual view.
art_direction_assessment.style_limit: This is a simple still clipart asset, not photorealistic art or an animated production model. It should not be presented as containing layers, rigging, animation or vector scalability. Its pale thin silhouette is unsuitable as the sole small scored cue.
art_direction_assessment.context: Display with the selected noun and definition. The general example mentions blue paper; this pink illustration depicts the noun category, not the exact event described by that sentence.
art_direction_assessment.root_review: Codex root independently inspected the crop sheet and accepted the contextual/library direction, while requiring 48px/20px isolated identification to remain disabled. This is AI review, not human picture approval.
